name: Tavern of Legendary Heroes
description: A rowdy medieval bar where legendary heroes come to drink ale and tell lies about their adventures. Wooden tables are carved with initials and quest logs. A roaring fireplace crackles merrily. The menu offers 'Dragon Wings' (chicken), 'Troll Brew' (beer), and 'Health Potions' (tomato juice). Adventurers compare swords, argue about XP distribution, and sing bawdy songs. A bard in the corner strums a lute, taking requests for gold. Someone's pet owlbear is definitely violating hotel policy.
